content:
Asha: FYI we detected a brief relevance regression impacting search results for some new onboarding indexes between 07:05-07:15 UTC. Early hit list: ShopDemo-1, LearnBeta-4, HealthPilot-2. Pulling full list. Need CS wording + mitigation. @Noah(CS) can you own comms?

Noah (CS): On it. Is this an embedding quality issue or an indexing delay? Customers care about missing or wrong results.

Kai (SRE): Quick summary: a featurization tweak rolled to encode-service changed similarity scaling for a subset of short-text documents; embeddings were accepted but similarity scores shifted, degrading ranking for some tenants. We rolled the tweak back at 07:12 UTC and scheduled a priority reindex for affected tenants.

deploy-bot: rollback completed: service/encode-service v2.1 -> v2.0. reindex job queued: reindex-4123456789.

Noah (CS): Thanks. Draft external phrasing (simple): "Hi <Name>, we saw short-lived search relevance issues between 07:05-07:15 UTC that may have returned unexpected results for some uploads. We reverted a recent internal change and reprocessed affected items. If you still see results that look off, reply and we'll prioritize a manual reindex and relevance-tuning session."

Lena (AE): ShopDemo-1 is in renewal talks; propose offering a "Renewal Assurance Package": 2 weeks of elevated support, a custom relevance tuning session, and a one-time service credit. That should help reduce churn risk.

Noah (CS): Good idea. I'll prepare two templates: standard (trials/smaller accounts) and assurance package (renewals). For standard offer: 60-min recovery session + 5% credit. For assurance: 2-week elevated support, 90-min tuning + direct AE/SRE sync, and a billing credit.

Kai (SRE): Operational note for CS: retries are running, queue shows ~40% processed; estimated completion ~45 mins. We'll attach reindex logs to the incident. Please avoid ML jargon externally; use "internal change" language.

Noah (CS): Draft assurance message (ShopDemo-1 style): "Hi <Name>, apologies  we experienced short-lived search relevance issues earlier today and prioritized your account. We've reprocessed your items and would like to offer a Renewal Assurance Package: two weeks of elevated support, a 90-minute custom relevance tuning session with our engineers, and a one-time billing credit. We'll also run a manual reindex and follow up with results. Reply with preferred times and we'll schedule immediately."

Lena (AE): Approved. Please include billing tag "incident-credit-4123456789" and CC me on the ShopDemo outreach. I'll be available for the tuning session.

Noah (CS): Will send high-touch to renewal accounts now, standard broadcast in 30m once reindex completes. Opening recovery office hours: Mon 10am PT / Thu 4pm CET. Booking link included in messages.

Kai (SRE): After queue drains we'll snapshot similarity distributions and add a guard to compare pre/post rollout metrics for future featurization changes. Also adding a smoke test that samples short-text payloads during deploys.

Asha: Great. Capture any customer feedback from tuning sessions into the RCA. Update execs with a one-paragraph summary by EOD. :thumbsup:
